What to check

Before booking installation, review these 3 quick checks to ensure perfect door and lock compatibility:

01

Measure the door and check the lock body

Measure the door at its edge and photograph the existing lock body and strike plate. If there is a grille, measure the space between the doors so the panel and handle have room to move.

02

Choose entry methods for the household

Compare fingerprint models if users are comfortable touching a reader, or face recognition if they often arrive with their hands full. Check the model specifications for cards or PINs that other household members use.

03

Compare handle and locking styles

Look at lever and push-pull designs. Check the door swing, how the door locks after closing and how you would normally open it from inside.
